messages.subject: subscript in title of plot
parts:
Can someone please help.
 How do you include a subscript in a plot title by passing it to main or opts( in ggplot2)

Thanks.

messages.author: cb65713c504cc909
messages.subject: Re: subscript in title of plot
parts:
Hi,

Using the expression argument you can create super- and subscripts

Here I inserted a subscript (inserted between "square brackets") in the title of the x axis:

ggplot(...)+...+labs(x=expression(y[2]))

Cheers
Ellen

messages.author: 5d4b04d12ddf9e18
messages.subject: Re: subscript in title of plot
parts:
Try:
x1 <- data.frame(x=1:10,y=(1:10)^2)
ggplot(x1, aes(x,y) ) + labs(x="X values", y = "Y values", title = expression(paste("Some text: ",x^2, "some more text: ",y[3]))) + geom_point()
